name: Starecrown
source:
There's an ancient legend of idols and angels...
Looking over who SHE deems worthy...
Unaware to those they watch...
[b]Until now.[/b]

In STARECROWN, you will learn why some things should stay the way they were through a visual-novel merged with a puzzle-based horror experience.
[b]But you won't be alone.[/b]
Just out of sight stands someone very familiar with you, fueled by words from an [b]ADVISOR [/b]hiding in the shadows. Who knows what might happen?

[b]There's only one way to find out, now is there?[/b]

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2814080/]Steam[/url]]
